purpose: Teach: 帯域/ファクター/環境省/入所/税務署/経済企画庁/自治省/付随

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 通信帯域の利用状況を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's check the communication bandwidth usage.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Steady pace, clear diction. Slight forward lean in posture — task-focused. No flourish, just directive clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。成功要因のファクター表を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare a factor analysis table for the success metrics.
lines.style: Agreeable, attentive tone. Flat energy — not reluctant, just efficient. Shows competence without needing reassurance. Brief, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 環境省のセミナーに参加しましょう
lines.en: Let's attend the Environmental Ministry seminar.
lines.style: Purposeful, measured direction. Even pace, no rush. Authority that comes from knowing what matters. Slight pause before the verb — making sure attention is there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修生の入所日を調整します
lines.en: Yes. I'll adjust the trainees' enrollment dates.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation with slight lift on 'adjust' — showing he's tracking the implication. Professional calm. Notes something down mentally. Minimal but present.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 税務署への提出書類を整理しましょう
lines.en: Let's organize the documents to submit to the tax office.
lines.style: Clean, directive tone. Brisk but not rushed. The confidence of someone who has done this before. Small emphasis on 'organize' — making the ask concrete.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経済企画庁OBの方をお招きします
lines.en: Yes. I'll reach out to a former EPA director I know.
lines.style: Steady, solution-oriented. Slight warmth on 'I know' — showing he's thinking of actual people, not just institutions. Competent ease. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 自治省時代の人脈も活かしましょう
lines.en: We should leverage the connections from your time at the Ministry of Local Government.
lines.style: Strategic, thoughtful direction. Slower pace — this is about relationships, not just tasks. Respect in the voice. Inviting his expertise without making it a question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。契約に付随する条件も明確にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll also clarify the conditions attached to the contract.
lines.style: Confident closing. The 'also' shows he's been listening and adding his own layer. Firm but not rigid. Lands solidly — conversation complete, next steps clear.
